title: Typed throws (Swift 6)

docs.title: Error Handling — Specifying the Error Type

hints: `throws(BankError)` declares exactly which error type can be thrown.
Throw `.invalidAmount` for non-positive amounts and `.insufficientFunds(short:)` when the amount exceeds the balance.
Inside the `map` closure, write `do throws(BankError) { … } catch { switch error { … } }` so `error` is a `BankError`.
